title: Attempting a smooth movement Traditional Roguelike in Hd 2D graphics. Any visual feedbacks??
author: Cosmonan

comments.author: CauseQueasy8023
comments.body: Shadows and character lighting are points i noticed first. They dont correspond to light sources you have in the game

replies.author: Cosmonan
replies.body: That's true, gonna have a look on it, thank you!

replies.author: CauseQueasy8023
replies.body:
Would also consider moving camera a bit further away since for ranged attacks obly enemies nearby are visible. 
You are going to add "breathing" animations for enemies later, right?

replies.author: Cosmonan
replies.body: You mean idle animations / squish and stretch? Yes I plan on adding those. As for the camera, you can actually zoom in and out with mouse scroll, but I didn't show that on the video 😄.

comments.author: florodude
comments.body: I kinda like this! You can keep that default "rogue"-esque play, but it's a new visual look.

replies.author: Cosmonan
replies.body: Exactly! I haven't found any traditional roguelikes with this kind of visual yet...

replies.author: IUsedToMakeMaps
replies.body:
Take a look at Ancient Domains of Mystery. Not for visual inspiration - but as to how far you can take a true "Roguelike." 

I played the original back in like 1984/1985. This was the first game I ever bought for my computer
